# War Scroll Column 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 2 | **Condition:** complete

---

**2:1** [...] the rule for the heads of the camps of the congregation; between forty and fifty years of age. And the organizers of the camps shall be between fifty and sixty years of age. And the officers

**2:2** [...] shall be between forty and fifty years of age. And all those who strip the slain, who plunder the spoil, who cleanse the land, who guard the weapons,

**2:3** and he who prepares the provisions — all these shall be between twenty-five and thirty years of age. And no youth or woman shall enter their camps when they march out from Jerusalem

**2:4** to go to war, until their return. And no one who is lame or blind or crippled, or a man having in his flesh a permanent blemish, or a man afflicted with an impurity of

**2:5** his flesh — all these shall not go forth with them to war. All of them shall be willing volunteers for war, perfect in spirit and body, and prepared for the day of vengeance. And any

**2:6** man who is not ritually pure with regard to his genitals on the day of battle shall not descend with them into battle, for holy angels are present together with their armies. And a space

**2:7** shall be between all their camps and the latrine, about two thousand cubits, and no indecent nakedness shall be seen in the surroundings of all their camps.

**2:8** And when they draw up the battle lines for war, to array the front line, there shall be between the lines a space of about seven

**2:9** lots with horsemen at their right and at their left. And the width of the gap between the lines shall be seven cubits for the battle formations of

**2:10** the warriors. And on the trumpets of summoning of the congregation they shall write: "Called of God." And on the trumpets of summoning of the leaders they shall write:

**2:11** "Princes of God." And on the trumpets of enrollment they shall write: "The Order of God." And on the trumpets of the notable men, the heads of

**2:12** the ancestral houses of the congregation, when they are assembled at the house of meeting, they shall write: "Testimonies of God for the Holy Council."

**2:13** And on the trumpets of the camps they shall write: "The Peace of God in the camps of his holy ones." And on the trumpets for breaking camp they shall write:

**2:14** "The Mighty Acts of God to scatter the enemy and to put to flight all who hate righteousness, and a withdrawal of covenant faithfulness from all who hate God."

**2:15** And on the trumpets of the battle formations they shall write: "Formations of the divisions of God for the vengeance of his anger against all the Sons of Darkness."

**2:16** And on the trumpets of summoning of the infantry, when the gates of war are opened for the infantry to go forth, they shall write: "A reminder of vengeance in the appointed time of God."

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 2 describes age requirements for various military roles and the inscriptions for the trumpets used at different stages of assembly and battle. Trumpet inscriptions are a distinctive feature of the War Scroll's liturgical-military synthesis. "Covenant faithfulness" for hesed maintains project convention.*
